items.title: Restore a bounded instrumentation ceiling for the current source inventory
items.context: The isolated command node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js fails identically on main and B-1fa6 with dynamicBindingBuilds=804 (synthetic=419, repo=385) against a stale absolute ceiling of 800. Adjust the source-of-truth assertion with documented headroom, rebuild dist, and prove the smoke still enforces boundedness.

happy.desc: After the source-of-truth ceiling is changed and packages/main is rebuilt, node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js exits 0 and emits its PASS line with dynamicBindingBuilds/builds=804 (synthetic=419, repo=385). The source names and documents a finite ceiling strictly above 804 but no greater than 850, so the current inventory is explicitly accepted with fixed small headroom rather than by deleting or weakening the assertion.

verification.selector: retired authority vocabulary guard PASS builds=804

happy.desc: A clean packages/main rebuild succeeds, the generated dist smoke contains the same ceiling and failure semantics as packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts, and the targeted smoke passes from rebuilt dist at the tested HEAD. A diff from the recorded B-5952 fork/base shows no change to docs/requirements/decisions/dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md.

edge.desc: The rebuilt committed smoke must execute the real assertDynamicBindingBuildBudget self-characterization before its PASS line: the configured ceiling is accepted, ceiling+1 throws with the observed/ceiling diagnostic, the measured build count throws when checked against measured-1, and any ceiling above the absolute hard cap 850 is rejected. Evidence must be an execution receipt from the actual smoke or equivalent exported guard call; standalone arithmetic, constant comparison, or source-text grep is insufficient.

verification.selector: retired authority vocabulary guard PASS builds=804

edge.desc: Two clean rebuild-and-smoke runs at unchanged HEAD are deterministic: source and dist remain bound, the targeted command remains PASS, and the measured current inventory does not gain unexplained headroom through cache or order variance. Any justified inventory-count drift must update the documented baseline and evidence instead of silently widening the ceiling.

verification.selector: retired authority vocabulary guard PASS builds=804

edge.desc: From a clean checkout whose repository marker is canonical proof-or-stop.config.json, node packages/main/dist/tasks/validate-command-timeout-smoke.js discovers the real repository root and exits 0; its temporary fixtures that intentionally provide only legacy lattice.config.json still resolve configured timeout overrides and retain their existing assertions. WHY: proves canonical root migration without breaking legacy fixture compatibility.

From the same clean canonical checkout with proof-or-stop.config.json and no repository-root lattice.config.json, node packages/main/tests/red/red-b3434-blob-buffer-ceiling.mjs locates the repository root, executes the real blob-buffer classification suite, and exits 0 with its PASS line instead of failing root discovery. WHY: pins canonical root discovery on the standalone RED regression.

When the red-evidence envelope smoke snapshots a fixture before a .lattice directory exists, the missing tree is represented deterministically and does not throw ENOENT; after fixture initialization its non-empty before/after manifest contract still detects mutations, and node packages/main/dist/tasks/red-evidence-envelope-smoke.js exits 0 with its OK line. WHY: missing runtime state must be an explicit snapshot state, not a crash or a weakened read-only assertion.

When the W2d read-only regression encounters an absent .lattice tree, snapshotting returns the same deterministic missing-state representation on repeated reads rather than throwing; once its fixture creates .lattice, the aggregate file-manifest comparison remains meaningful, canonical proof-or-stop.config.json resolves the registered smoke, its legacy temporary lattice.config.json fixture still works, and node packages/main/tests/red/red-w2d-command-readonly.mjs exits 0 with PASS.

From a clean checkout containing canonical proof-or-stop.config.json but no repository-root lattice.config.json, node packages/main/tests/red/red-b8df9-init-check-verdict-signature.mjs reads its current validation registration, reaches the GREEN signature-domain verdict, and exits 0; the isolated repositories it creates with legacy lattice.config.json continue to bootstrap and exercise the same CLI flow. WHY: canonical registration lookup must not invalidate legacy test projects.

verification.selector: GREEN: both verdict fields are inside the signature domain

adversarial.desc: An isolated executable mutation harness must prove the guard is causal: mutate the real comparator to an unbounded form and separately replace the ceiling with sentinel 900, rebuild or execute the mutated artifact, and require each mutant run to fail the characterization while the unmodified control passes. The harness must assert that each substitution occurred and must reject a no-op mutation; arithmetic-only checks and source-text presence checks are insufficient.
